podcast.body: This was one of the nine songs performed by The Vicious White Kids at their single concert at the Electric Ballroom. It was an old Eddie Cochran song dedicated to Nancy Spungen, which they repeated three times over three sets. "Sid Vicious and the Vicious White Kids doing the old studio song, a one-up of your dog dedicated to Nancy, no less."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
